__doc__: THE PUBLIC CONTRACT — current opening boundary.
This file declares the anonymous/public relations the browser and the build-time SEO loader may consume.
scripts/r410-public-contract-reconciliation.mjs rebuilds the migration chain and reconciles this declaration
against information_schema, actual grants, the loader relation list, and the SEO fixture.
status: 'live'  — relation exists and is intentionally anonymous-readable.
status: 'built' — relation exists but must NOT be anonymous-readable.
status: 'retired' — retained only as historical context and ignored by public consumers.
loader_columns_must_match_view: true means the SEO loader must request the complete view projection,
not merely a subset. This is used for public_site_configuration so saved legal/contact details and
section visibility flags cannot disappear from static output or the last-known-good snapshot.
__ceiling_note__: Current allow-list contains 10 anonymous SELECT relations. T13.3.10 removed the obsolete site_settings base-table grant; public_site_configuration is the only anonymous settings source.
__stale_policy_note__: Legacy menu/store policies may still name anon while the base-table grants are revoked. The reconciliation suite proves they remain unreadable and fails if this set changes unexpectedly.
